_about: CT40.A12.Solari fields definition. Defines the drums (what each flap unit can show, in flip order), the field types built from them, and the columns of the board (left to right). Column labels live in CT40.A12.Solari.schedule.json.

drums._about: Each drum lists every glyph a flap unit can show, in the order the flaps fall. A change always advances forward through the list (A->E shows B, C, D) and wraps around, exactly like a real Solari drum. 'plate': false means a printed, non-flapping character (the colon).

ampmIcon._about: A11: the AM/PM flap of each row shows a picture instead of letters - the sun ('sun 2') for AM, the moon ('moon 1') for PM. Any glyph of any drum may have an image; the glyph text is used when the image is missing.
ampmIcon._imageCrop: fraction of the picture (centred) shown on the flap: 0.8 drops the decorative border so the face reads at flap size; 1 = the whole picture

types._about: A field type is a sequence of cells. 'alphanumeric' is N alnum cells (N = the column's length). 'time' is H H : M M then the AM/PM flap (A11: a sun / moon picture, drum ampmIcon).

board._size: size of the master clock and flap rows as a fraction of full-window fit (0.2-1.0); the Size -/+ buttons change it live and the browser remembers your choice
board._labelSize: size of the title and column headings (fixed; not changed by the Size buttons)

clock._about: Master clock at top centre, drawn with the same flaps. Format h:mm:ss AM/PM.
clock._sound: clack when the clock flaps change (every second). The C key toggles it live.
clock._ampmDrum: drum used for the master clock's AM/PM flap: 'ampm' (letters, default) or 'ampmIcon' (sun / moon)

sound._about: Clack sample for each flap landing. Default ON. 'slice' is the part of one.wav used per flap, in seconds (the file holds two strikes; the first is the sharp metal one). maxVoicesPerFrame caps simultaneous clacks so a whole-board change roars instead of clipping.
sound._loudness: make-up gain after the compressor; a limiter stops clipping. Raise for louder at the same slider position.

decor._about: A11: rows of the user's icons (the whole picture, uncropped) along the top and bottom of the sign. 'height' is the band height as a fraction of the window height (clamped to minPx-maxPx). The I key shows / hides them.
decor._repeat: repeat the list to fill the width of the window
